What to do on Game Day Make the most of game day in Minneapolis by exploring the nearby area. Grab local bites at top restaurants, visit iconic attractions, and soak in the city's electric atmosphere before heading to the stadium. Sports Teams All the teams. All the stadiums. All right here. The crack of the bat. The roar of the purple-painted crowd. The howl-worthy dunks. Catch the sports action without ever leaving downtown. Whether you’re cheering for home or away, you’ll love that our impressive stadiums are right here and within walking distance of each other - and all the action of the city.
